name: Online Best-Agree Mainline (FA3)
blurb: Runnable derivative scaffold of the current strongest open-PR line: Loader + Full GPTQ + XSA-all plus a causal online token/within-word/word-start agreement overlay packaged in the record folder. Metrics pending verification on this fork.
